data.name: Fatihun
data.gender_notes: Fatihun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who opens the way or conquers obstacles. The name Fatihun carries the meaning “Opener, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fatihun usually hope their child will grow to embody opener, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the opening of the heart to faith and the conquest of inner obstacles
data.etymology: Fatihun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Opener, Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatihun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: فاتحون
in_arabic.meaning: فاتحون: الفتح والنصر والتمكين من الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاتحون هو اسم مشتق من الفاتح، الذي يعني الفتح والنصر والتمكين من الله تعالى. يدل على الشخص الذي يفتح أبواب الخير والنجاح والتمكين، ويتميز بالقدرة على تحقيق الأهداف والانتصار على التحديات. في القرآن الكريم، يرتبط الفتح بالنصر الإلهي والتمكين للمسلمين. اسم فاتحون يعبر عن الأمل والثقة في نصر الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: فاتحون
in_urdu.meaning: فاتحون: فتح کرنے والا، نصرت حاصل کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاتحون ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ف-ت-ح' جڑ سے بنا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فتح کرنا، نصرت حاصل کرنا۔ یہ نام اس شخص کی خصوصیت ہے جو اچھائی اور کامیابی کے دروازے کھولتا ہے، اور چیلنجوں پر قابو پانے کی صلاحیت رکھتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، فتح کا تعلق الہی نصرت اور مسلمانوں کے لیے تمکین سے ہے۔ نام فاتحون امید اور اللہ تعالیٰ کی نصرت پر بھروسے کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फातिहुन
in_hindi.meaning: फातिहुन: जीतने वाला, सफलता प्राप्त करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: फातिहुन एक अरबी नाम है जो 'फ-त-ह' मूल से बना है, जिसका अर्थ है जीतना, सफलता प्राप्त करना। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति की विशेषता है जो अच्छाई और सफलता के द्वार खोलता है, और चुनौतियों पर काबू पाने की क्षमता रखता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, فتح का संबंध ईश्वरीय विजय और मुसलमानों के लिए सशक्तिकरण से है। नाम फातिहुन आशा और ईश्वर की विजय पर भरोसे का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: فاتحون
in_pashto.meaning: فاتحون: د فتح او بريا راوړونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فاتحون د عربي نوم څخه مشتق دی، چي د 'ف-ت-ح' ريښې څخه جوړ شوی دی، مانې يې د فتح او بريا راوړل. دا نوم د هغه چا ځانګړتیا ده، چي د خير او بريا د دروازو پراني، او د ننګونو د ماتولو توان لري. په اسلامي دود کې، فتح د الهي بريا او د مسلمانانو د تمکين سره تړاو لري. نوم فاتحون د اميد او الهي بريا باندي د باور څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: Fatihun
in_english.meaning: Fatihun: Bringer of victory, opener of doors to success
in_english.long_meaning: Fatihun is derived from the Arabic root 'f-t-h', meaning 'to open', 'to conquer', or 'to bring victory'. This name signifies a person who brings about success, opens doors to opportunities, and possesses the ability to overcome challenges. In Islamic tradition, 'Fatih' relates to divine conquest and empowerment for Muslims. The name Fatihun embodies hope, trust in divine victory, and the promise of achieving great things through faith and perseverance.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: فا-تی-ہون

data.cultural_impact: The name "Fatihun" in Islamic culture carries the meaning of 'one who opens the way'. This name is deeply rooted in the historic acts of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who, through his conquests, opened new avenues of knowledge, spiritual growth, and social development for the Muslim Ummah. The name is also a reminder of the Islamic principle of striving against all odds to expand the scope of peace, prosperity, and righteousness in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name "Fatihun" evokes the concept of 'faithful victory.' It speaks to the belief that, with unwavering faith in Allah, one can overcome any personal, emotional, or spiritual obstacle and emerges with a sense of achievement, inner peace, and closer relationship with the Divine. The name is a reminder to stay steadfast in faith, continue persevering through life's challenges, and trust in Allah's guidance throughout the journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Opener, Conqueror" symbolizes One who opens the way or conquers obstacles. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fatihun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of opener, conqueror.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fatihun was the name of the Ottoman sultan Mehmed II who conquered Constantinople in 1453. The name Fatihun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Fatihun was a title given to Mehmed II due to his conquest of Constantinople.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Fatihun remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Maryam Fatihun in Istanbul, Turkey attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Fatihun, which means "Opener, Conqueror". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
